data.fund_name: SBI Retirement Benefit Fund - Conservative Hybrid Plan
data.fund_type: An open-ended retirement solution oriented scheme having a lock-in of 5 years or till retirement age (whichever is earlier)
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to provide a comprehensive retirement saving solution that serves the variable needs of the investors through long term diversified investments in major asset classes. However there can be no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be realized.
